text: One RTX 4090 (24 GB) instead of the planned RTX A4500 (20 GB): the whole bf16 model (incl. the input embedding) is on the GPU; fixed batch 16 per task in every arm (exp30 used 8/10).
HF_HOME was not set to ./hf_cache (plan STEP 0): the run's shared cache variables were kept, as the run instructions require; the model weights are not in this folder.
Generation caps are exp30's 384 (bench) / 512 (T2) tokens, not 1,024/1,536: engine-check comparability with exp30 and the time budget; truncations are counted per cell (results/cells.json, n_length).

U3 (packed vs separate forwards) and U4 (cached vs full forward) miss the strict tolerances: max 0.27 nats per 48-token program (mean 0.10) and 0.16 nats contrast; both are bf16 kernel-shape effects (batch size / mask path), so every compared condition of a pair is scored in ONE batched forward (none, full-state and edits together).
Commit #0 holds the design, thresholds, cells, seeds and predictions; the analysis code was frozen in amendment2_analysis_code before any held-out generation was scored.

Distinct 48-token openings are few (the model repeats openings), so the default pool was extended to TRAIN-family padding-twin samples (commit1_<task>_v2 amendment); validation target sets are filled from training programs where < 8 distinct programs exist; T10 dfs has 3 distinct programs, T03 heapify_pop 1 and full_sort 2 (T03 short-program fallback: >= 16 tokens).

The declared band fallback fired on both core tasks (full-state at L* transferred -0.03 on T2 and 0.00 on T10 in generation vs 0.33 / 0.57 for band 12-23), so every map acts at the spec positions of blocks 12-23 (one R shared over the band).

AMENDMENT 1 (committed before any held-out generation): the committed contrastive objective C = LME_Y - LME_D diverged on validation (best states: T2 main 1,873 nats, permuted 880 nats; T10 main 3,868 nats vs full-state ceilings of 5-36 nats): it rises through breakage of the default's likelihood, as the plan warned. A second map per task was fitted with the bounded standard DAS objective LME_Y (likelihood of the source's own programs), same class, pairs, seeds and budget, with its permuted-label and read-position twins. The full held-out cell set uses this map (MAIN_LY); the committed map (MAIN) is reported from a 10-slot generation pilot (results/committed_map_pilot.json).
T10's committed-objective fit is MAIN only (no permuted / read-position fits with the degenerate objective); T03 uses only the amended objective (MAIN_LY + PERM_LY).
PCA-16 uses per-position-centred spec states of the TRAIN forced prompts (15 spec-mean points give rank <= 14); DIM-1, the natural-state analyses and M use the band's middle block (18).
Held-out teacher-forced evaluation scores held-out PROMPT pairs with the training target program sets (no separate held-out target sets).
Decisive MAIN_LY cells ran straight to N = 30 (no separate 10-slot pass); the profile confirmation cells served as the machinery pilot.

Forced-source transfers use the pooled padding-twin BASE cell of the plan (slot s: family 3 + s mod 2, kept Y (s div 2) mod |Y|), so the forced arms' base prompt can differ in padding length from the arm's own padding twin on a slot.
Drop order applied: plan resampling (1) and the T1 extension (2: T1 DAS and the literal top-five placement on T1) were not run; M's top-k placement uses T2's leave-one-survivor bans only.
One init seed per fit (plan departure 2); no second T2 seed.

The committed random-init control (contrastive objective, results/randinit_T2.json) was compared with the trained contrastive fit, which had diverged (ratio 0.013 is not meaningful). A matched control (results/randinit_ly_T2.json: the random network fitted with the amended LME_Y objective, compared with MAIN_LY in the same units) decides P1's T2 random-init clause; the analysis code change is an addition made after generation.
Extensions beyond the plan: behaviour of the prompts M places (MGEN cells, N = 30 each; the LF2 long-form instruction with cap 1,536) and a second DAS init seed on T2 (DASLY2 arms).
C is scored at k = 16 when P1's k (2 on T2, 16 on T10) has no forced-source DAS arm (forced sources were generated at k in {1, 4, 16}).
